title: SSRIs that made him suicidal; his psychiatrist quit

tellings.quote: then they put me on those meds that made me suicidal and that's why my first doctor quit.

plain: In 2016 and 2017, the former Air Force serviceman Dylan Borland says, doctors at the VA put him on SSRIs, a common kind of antidepressant, that made him suicidal. He tells Michels "that's why my first doctor quit", pointing to his VA medical records. He tells it as part of what happened to him after the experiences he describes, and as a sign of how he was treated.
